game.play.title: Play Kana Rush
game.play.description: Type the romaji of each kana bubble before it crosses the field.
game.play.intro: Type the reading in romaji. The first bubble that matches becomes your target; Backspace releases it.
game.play.unavailable: This list could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
game.play.inputLabel: Type the romaji of a bubble
game.blocked.title: Try Kana Rush on a computer
game.blocked.text: The game is built around a real keyboard and needs a wider screen. Open this page on a desktop or laptop to play.
game.title: Kana Rush: a kana typing game
game.description: Pop kana bubbles by typing their romaji before they cross the field. Hiragana, katakana and kanji, four difficulties, challenge and endless modes.
game.lead: Type the reading in romaji. Each bubble pops when its full word or sentence is typed.
game.difficulty.easy.note: Easy: single kana, slow bubbles, 7 lives.
game.difficulty.normal.note: Normal: words of 2–4 kana, medium speed, 5 lives.
game.difficulty.hard.note: Hard: words with dakuten, combinations and small っ, fast, 3 lives.
game.difficulty.extreme.note: Extreme: short real sentences, 3 lives, and every 5 wrong keys cost a life.
game.saved: Progress is saved in this browser. No account required.
game.option.hint: Show romaji hint on first miss
game.results.chart.desc: WPM started at {start} and ended at {end}, with a peak of {peak} at {peakAt}. Seconds with errors: {errors}.
game.results.chart.empty: No keys were typed in this run.

game.share.name: Name on card (optional)
game.share.copyFailed: Couldn't copy the image. Use Download PNG instead.
game.option.reduce.note: Slower bubbles, no shake. On by default when your system asks for less motion.
game.option.cues.note: Adds shapes to colours: underlined kana, marked keys.
